regs.name: Imithetho yokwakha
regs.hint: Faka itiki emaphakhejini ukuze abhalwe ephaneli Yemithetho; imidwebo engenayo amamaki ayo ihlolwa ngawo. Amaphakheji avela ezifundeni ozikhethe ku-Izilungiselelo › Global › Imithetho yokwakha, ahlelwe ngendawo. Iphakheji liqukethe izinombolo namanani eziqephu, hhayi umbhalo wesitandadi. Umhlahlandlela nje: igunya elibhalisiwe nomasipala wendawo yiwo anquma.
regs.unavailable: Amaphakheji emithetho awakwazanga ukufundwa. Amathuluzi ezitebhisi agcina imikhawulo yawo ehlanganisiwe.
regs.state.draft: Uhlaka: kufakwe ngokusuka ekhodini eshicilelwe, kakabuyekezwa ingoti elibhalisiwe.

regs.rg.hint: Faka itiki emazweni osebenza kuwo. Amaphakheji awo avela kuMtapo weCadCraft futhi agcinwa kulolu khompyutha zonke izinhlelo, ngakho ukuhlola kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Vula izwe ukuze ubone amaphakheji alo.

regs.p.title: Imithetho
regs.p.nomodel: Vula noma qala imodeli: amamaki alapha agcinwa emdwebeni.
regs.p.defaultsused: Lo mdwebo awunawo amamaki wawo okwamanje: kusebenza izinto ozikhethele zona ku-Izilungiselelo. Shintsha itiki ukuze uzigcine emdwebeni.
regs.p.empty: Akukho phakheji oludwetshiwe. Khetha izifunda ku-Izilungiselelo › Global namaphakheji ku-Izilungiselelo › BimCraft.
regs.sheet.title: Isifinyezo sekhodi

regs.sheet.nodraw: Vula i-Draw ukuze umdwebo uhlolwe, bese wenza ishidi futhi.
